quesContent: What is the problem you are experiencing with your computer?

choices.answerContent: My computer is running very slowly. It freezes when I try to open two programs at once, and sometimes the whole screen turns blue and the computer just restarts itself. The performance is very poor.
choices.description: Elementary answer with basic grammar and common expressions.

choices.answerContent: I'm experiencing severe system slowdown and performance bottlenecks. The machine suffers from frequent application lag and unprompted system reboots (Blue Screen). This points to potential issues with RAM integrity or a corrupt driver requiring urgent diagnosis.
choices.description: Intermediate response with varied vocabulary and clear structure.

quesContent: When did the issue first occur?

choices.answerContent: The issue first occurred about three days ago, last Friday. It started right after I installed a new program. The problem has gotten much worse since then, with the computer now restarting by itself.
choices.description: Elementary answer with basic grammar and common expressions.

choices.answerContent: The problem was first noticeable four to five days ago, immediately following a routine OS update and graphics driver installation. It quickly deteriorated from minor lag to the first 'Blue Screen' system reboot occurring this past Saturday.
choices.description: Intermediate response with varied vocabulary and clear structure.

quesContent: Have you tried restarting your device?

choices.answerContent: Yes, I have tried restarting it many times. It runs a little faster for ten minutes after the restart, but the slow performance problem quickly returns, and the programs start freezing.
choices.description: Elementary answer with basic grammar and common expressions.

choices.answerContent: Yes, I performed multiple system reboots. The restart only provides a temporary, marginal improvement. The system lag and unprompted reboots always return shortly after, which confirms that the restart is not addressing the underlying root cause.
choices.description: Intermediate response with varied vocabulary and clear structure.

quesContent: Are there any error messages appearing on the screen?

choices.answerContent: Yes, I see error messages. The main one is the blue screen that appears before the restart, which says, 'Your PC ran into a problem.' I also get frequent pop-ups saying, 'Program X has stopped working.'
choices.description: Elementary answer with basic grammar and common expressions.

choices.answerContent: Yes, I encounter two critical errors. First, the 'Blue Screen of Death' (BSOD), which once displayed the code 'MEMORY_MANAGEMENT'. Second, applications frequently crash, showing an 'unhandled exception' pop-up stating the program has stopped responding.
choices.description: Intermediate response with varied vocabulary and clear structure.

quesContent: What troubleshooting steps have you already attempted?

choices.answerContent: I have already restarted the computer several times, but the issue returns. I also closed all running programs to free up memory, and I ran a full virus scan, but none of these steps helped the performance.
choices.description: Elementary answer with basic grammar and common expressions.

choices.answerContent: I performed multiple full system reboots and ran a complete antivirus/malware scan, both of which were ineffective. I also checked for and installed the latest driver updates for the graphics and chipset, but the performance bottlenecks and BSOD errors persist.
choices.description: Intermediate response with varied vocabulary and clear structure.
